memory_lessons.applicability: Stencil x-loop experiments in this campaign.
memory_lessons.claim: The valid row-base-plus-SIMD candidate measured 0.0813 seconds and the valid no-directive pointer-induction candidate measured 0.4494 seconds, but their access patterns also differ; these results do not establish the directive's independent effect.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Compare this directive-only candidate against the indexed baseline and the prior row-base candidate, measuring both core budgets including setup.

proposal.hypothesis: Adding only a compile-gated OpenMP SIMD directive to the existing indexed x loop tests whether an explicit vectorization hint helps without row-base hoisting. The prior valid row-base-plus-SIMD candidate measured 0.0813 seconds, while the no-directive pointer-induction candidate measured 0.4494 seconds; those differ in both access form and directive, so they do not isolate the cause. This candidate tests whether the directive alone helps, while retaining generic x bounds and making no alignment or ISA assumption.

retained: Added an OpenMP SIMD directive immediately before the existing contiguous-x loop, guarded by _OPENMP >= 201307.
Kept the original indexed accesses, recurrence expression, initialization, boundaries, and scalar fallback unchanged.
